factor_diagnostics.value_notes: The aquaculture/life-history synthesis reports Florida pompano avoid water below about 20 °C, with mortality at 10–12 °C; spawning, larval development, and juvenile growth are reported optimal around 25–30 °C. These are physiological and early-life-stage data, not a calibrated adult surf-zone catch curve. They support the broad 18–30 °C range but do not validate the 22–27 °C ideal for adult fish.
